checks.detail: BN (long double arg1 @ st0, int32_t arg2, float arg3 @ 0xc): arg1 is the x87 value, arg2 is the [E+4] result slot, arg3 is the [E+0xc] frame. The candidate (long param_1, int32_t param_2, float param_3) puts param_1 at [E+4], param_2 at [E+8] and param_3 at [E+0xc]. It reads the frame from the right slot (param_3) but writes the result record to param_2 = [E+8], the argc word, instead of param_1 = [E+4].The retail result slot is [E+4] (arg1 in BN's model). This candidate writes the 0x18-byte return record to [E+8] (its param_2/arg2), overwriting the argc word instead of the result buffer.
